goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

committed_budget.source: LOCKED compute budget (2026-08-10, re-locked from 10M/384). The canonical kernel train.ipynb runs at EXACTLY this. 10M/384 was non-convergent (2.26 BPC, ~12x fewer steps per epoch) -> RE-LOCKED to 30M/96 which converges; this matches the old best run's budget but with warmup 150 + steps_per_execution 16 + vectorized datasets (fit time dropped ~59min -> ~34min). These are compute levers only: DO NOT inflate limit_chars/epochs/block_size to lower loss (compute inflation, rejected by push rule). Architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_*, dropout, lr, weight_decay, ...) are NOT locked and MAY be tuned/swept. Steps/epoch auto-rescale to actual batch via steps_per_epoch_estimate().

current_best.time_to_convergence: ~34 min (2038s runtime / 2016s fit) to 1.6826 BPC @ E40 at locked 30M/512/40ep/bs96 budget. Crossed the previous best (1.8833) by E10 (~5 min of fit). ~1.7x faster fit than the old 59min best.
current_best.notes: Iter-19 (v27): FIRST RUN AT RE-LOCKED BUDGET. 10M/384 was non-convergent (hardy-aardvark-18 w7to9wg0 = 2.2631 BPC, ~12x fewer steps) so budget re-locked to 30M/96. Added token_qk_norm (v34 probe) on top of monotonic token-dec scaling. Token-dec lever (layers/dim_ff): 3L/256=1.8759 (z29pp538) -> 4L/384=1.8483 (dfifxp5i) -> 5L/512=1.794 (oywizfcm) -> 6L/768=1.7187 (8dapi5ep) -> 7L/896=1.7047 (in2kuivh) -> 7L/896+token_qk_norm=1.6826 (ffjthxm3, NEW BEST). Chunk-dec 12L/2560 scale-up (tyz4oya5 prime-mountain-21) REGRESSED 1.8483->1.8749 so reverted to 8L/2048. Iter-20 (v35) = continue token-dec lever to 8L/1024 + token_qk_norm. Progression: 3.493 -> 3.268 -> 3.011 -> 2.5909 -> 2.3023 -> 2.2878 -> 2.2597 -> 1.8869 -> 1.8833 -> [1.9049 bigram regression] -> [v25 QK-norm build ERROR] -> 1.8759 -> 1.8483 -> 1.794 -> 1.7187 -> 1.7047 -> 1.6826.

historical_source.note: Provenance kept for the agent's startup context. Identifiers (kernel slug, W&B entity/project/sweep/run) are NOT committed publicly — they are supplied to the runtime via GitHub Actions env vars / repository variables (WANDB_ENTITY, WANDB_PROJECT, WANDB_SWEEP_ID) and Kaggle secrets. Treat these fields as opaque labels when reading this file in the public mirror.

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.

next_iteration_directions: Iter-20 (v35, in flight): continue the winning token-dec lever to 8L/1024 + token_qk_norm (kept from v34). Token-dec scaling is the ONLY lever that has monotonically improved BPC: 3L:1.876 -> 4L:1.848 -> 5L:1.794 -> 6L:1.719 -> 7L:1.705 -> 7L+qk:1.6826. Expect diminishing returns — if 8L/1024 regresses, lock 7L/896+qk and switch levers.

If token-dec saturates, next lever candidates: (a) lr sweep around 9e-4 (token-dec growth may shift optimal lr), (b) token_emb_dim 128->256, (c) chunk_local_window=128 (local-causal chunk attention), (d) re-enable online W&B sweep over the token-dec neighborhood {7,8}x{896,1024}x qk_norm.
Chunk-dec scale-up (12L/2560) already REGRESSED (1.8483->1.8749, tyz4oya5) — do not revisit chunk_dec_layers>8 / chunk_dec_dim_ff>2048 without a new hypothesis.
Add ModelCheckpoint every epoch + resume-on-restart so a TPU session timeout never loses progress.
Evaluate ALiBi for chunk-level attention (currently forced off in TF due to slow impl).
Add a true text8 evaluation path (alternative corpus to cross-validate generalization).
